Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Many thanks for [this payment](/topic/160), which considering that I had £400 before ought indeed to satisfy me.
I wonder when [Clay](/organisation/173) means to go on with the [Scripture readings](/book/87)

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The final volume of CMY\'s Scripture Readings was not in fact published until 1879, but that this was entirely the printer\'s fault is not certain.
